question: The test that allows comparing two means of independent samples when the variable is not normally distributed is:

options.opa: Student's t test of two independent samples with n1 + n2 degrees of freedom.
options.opb: Student's t test of two independent samples with (n1 + n2) -2 degrees of freedom.
options.opc: Student's t test of two independent samples with (n1 + n2) -1 degrees of freedom.
